info.title: Tenant management service
info.description: The tenant management service includes APIs for common platform capabilities like retrieving tenant information.

post.description:
Deprecated; use POST /api/tenant/v2/tenants, which shares this endpoint's implementation but also validates the name length and characters. Creates a tenant. Requires the core realm beta-tester or tenant-service-admin role; tenant users are rejected even with those roles.

By default a new realm is created for the tenant, with the current user as the administrator; the response is sent with status 202 while the realm is provisioned. Users with the tenant-service-admin role can instead set realm to associate the tenant with an existing realm, in which case adminEmail is required and the response is sent with status 200. Only tenant-service-admin users can set realm or adminEmail.

name.description: Name of the tenant. Must be unique (ignoring case) and must not contain special characters such as ! & % - or /.

realm.description: Existing realm to associate with the tenant. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

adminEmail.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

newRealm.summary: Create a tenant with a new realm

200.description: Tenant is created with an existing realm.

202.description: Tenant is created and its realm is being provisioned.

400.description: The name is missing, the name is invalid or already used, the administrator already has a tenant, or the realm is already associated with a tenant or set without adminEmail.

constraints.isDefined: name should not be null or undefined

value.errorMessage: Value not valid for Tenant name: This tenant name has already been used. Please enter a different tenant name.

delete.description: Deprecated; use DELETE /api/tenant/v2/tenants/{id}, after looking up the tenant ID with GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?realm={realm}. Deletes the tenant with the given realm, and the realm. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: Realm of the tenant to delete.

200.description: Tenant deletion completed. success is false if the realm or the tenant record wasn't deleted.

example.errorMessage: tenant with ID 'realm: 2f6c8f1e-3b7a-4d5c-9e8f-1a2b3c4d5e6f' could not be found.

post.description: Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?adminEmail={email}, which limits tenant users to their own tenant. Retrieves the tenant with the given administrator email. Available to any authenticated user of any tenant or the core realm; no role is required.

Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?name={name}, which limits tenant users to their own tenant. Retrieves the tenant with the given name, ignoring case. Available to any authenticated user of any tenant or the core realm; no role is required.

get.description: Deprecated; there is no v2 replacement. Returns the Keycloak roles of the realm that issued the current user's token, which is the user's own tenant realm. Requires the tenant-admin role.

Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?realm={realm}, which limits tenant users to their own tenant. Retrieves a tenant by realm. Available to any authenticated user of any tenant or the core realm; no role is required.
Internal endpoint used by the tenant admin webapp. Checks if the given user in the core realm is linked to the default ADSP identity provider. Requires the tenant-admin role and is rate limited.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user in the core realm.

200.description: Whether the user is linked to the default identity provider in the core realm.

400.description: userId is missing, or the identity providers of the user could not be read.

constraints.isDefined: userId should not be null or undefined

checkFailed.summary: Identity providers could not be read

value.errorMessage: Failed to check the goa-ad IdP in core for user 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a due to Request failed with status code 404

get.description: Internal endpoint used by the tenant admin webapp. Looks up the ID of the user with the given email in a realm, which defaults to the core realm. Requires the tenant-admin role and is rate limited.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: Realm to look up the user in. Defaults to core.

200.description: ID of the user, or null if there is no user with the email.

delete.description: Internal endpoint used by the tenant admin webapp. Removes the link between a user and an identity provider in a realm. Requires the tenant-admin role and is rate limited.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user in the realm.

parameters.name: idpName
parameters.description: Alias of the identity provider. Defaults to goa-ad.

400.description: A required parameter is missing, or the identity provider link could not be removed.

constraints.isDefined: realm should not be null or undefined

value.errorMessage: Failed to delete the IdP goa-ad from user 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a due to Request failed with status code 404

get.description: Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants/{id}, which limits tenant users to their own tenant. Retrieves a tenant by ID. Available to any authenticated user of any tenant or the core realm, and not limited to the user's own tenant; no role is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

get.description:
Search for active tenants; tenants that are still provisioning are not included. No role is required. Authenticated tenant users only find their own tenant; authenticated core users, including service accounts, can find any tenant.

Anonymous requests (without a valid bearer token) are allowed if they include the name or realm criteria, and the results do not include the administrator email.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the tenant, matched as a whole and ignoring case.

parameters.name: adminEmail
parameters.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Anonymous requests must also include name or realm.

anonymous.summary: Anonymous request, without the administrator email

401.description: Anonymous request does not include name or realm criteria.

example.errorMessage: Request must include realm id or name criteria.

post.description:
Create a tenant. Requires the core realm beta-tester or tenant-service-admin role; tenant users are rejected even with those roles.

By default a new realm is created for the tenant, with the current user as the administrator; the response is sent with status 202 while the realm is provisioned, and a beta-tester who is already the administrator of a tenant is rejected. Users with the tenant-service-admin role can instead set realm to associate the tenant with an existing realm, in which case adminEmail is required and the response is sent with status 200. Only tenant-service-admin users can set realm or adminEmail.

name.description: Name of the tenant. Must be unique, ignoring case.

realm.description: Existing realm to associate with the tenant. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

adminEmail.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

newRealm.summary: Create a tenant with a new realm

200.description: Tenant created with an existing realm.

202.description: Tenant created and its realm is being provisioned.

400.description: Request is invalid, for example the name is invalid or already used, the administrator already has a tenant, or the realm is already associated with a tenant or set without adminEmail.

value.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): name (body) - Invalid value
Value not valid for Tenant name: This tenant name has already been used. Please enter a different tenant name.
test.admin@gov.ab.ca is the tenant admin in our record. One user can create only one realm.

401.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token, the user does not have the required role, or a user without the tenant-service-admin role set realm or adminEmail.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

get.description: Retrieves a tenant. No role is required, but the request must be authenticated. Tenant users can only retrieve their own tenant, and get 403 for any other tenant ID; core users can retrieve any tenant.

403.description: Tenant user is not permitted to retrieve another tenant.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a) not permitted to get tenant.

delete.description: Deletes a tenant and its realm. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role, which can delete any tenant; tenant users are rejected.

200.description: Tenant deletion completed. success is false if the realm or the tenant record wasn't deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

patch.description: Update the tenant name. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role, which can rename any tenant; tenant users, including tenant administrators, are rejected. Rate limited.

TenantBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a parameter failed validation.

example.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): name (body) - Invalid value
Tenant with ID '61f2e3a8c9b1d2e3f4a5b6c7' could not be found.

TenantTooManyRequests.description: Too many requests; limited to 200 requests per 5 minutes.

text/plain.example: Too many requests, please try again later.

TenantUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token, or the user does not have the role required for the operation. Role checks in this API respond with 401 rather than 403.

realm.description: Keycloak realm of the tenant, which is the issuer of the tenant's access tokens.

status.description: Status of the tenant; a new tenant is provisioning until its realm has been created.

adminEmail.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Not included for anonymous requests.

example.errorMessage: Tenant with ID '61f2e3a8c9b1d2e3f4a5b6c7' could not be found.

constraints.isDefined: email should not be null or undefined
